representations_and_conversion_obligatio.notes: Unfolded all endpoint-relevant header definitions and verified the correspondence claims. ell=lam.toNat is identified with lam only under nonnegativity; Idx=Fin(ell+1) includes both endpoints and is nonempty. Scalar weights subtract in ℂ after casting, agreeing with the specified integer subtraction; natural subtraction is confined to bounded indices. ev is the divided-power vector, not a basis assertion. P=projector in the source is Y_ell X_ell, and integralMatrix is X_(ell−i) Q Y_(ell−j). In the pinned Mathlib, Module.End multiplication is composition (rightmost first), and 1 is identity. coeffProd and coeffOmit are the specified finite products, including empty product 1. latticeEnd is an actual scalar-restricted map when preservation holds and zero otherwise; T002 explicitly proves preservation and agreement for A, every divided power, and x,y,h, and proves the commutator and four-factor restriction identity. Consequently its fallback branch cannot silently replace the original operators under the theorem hypotheses. TensorLeft and TensorRight are the actual ℤ tensor products in the two orders. Pinned TensorProduct.comm swaps pure tensors; AddEquiv.module transports only the scalar action while preserving the existing additive group; AddEquiv.linearEquiv makes that very map linear. Pinned LinearMap.baseChange acts on the M factor of K⊗ℤM. Thus induced is conjugation of the correct base change, not an unrelated representation. T011 is an unconditional planned bridge proving the right-factor K-action, pure-tensor swap, induced evaluation and intertwining. T004 uses it to transport dimension, nonzeroness, matrix units and invariance back to the original order. These obligations suffice for both directions of the actual representation change; their bodies remain required at assembly. No construction field assumes P. Nontrivial means the tensor space is nonzero; stable and bottom/top express the stated subspaces. Invariance under x,y,h is equivalent to invariance under the prescribed L_K action by closure under K-linear combinations and evaluation on its three generators, without division by 2 or a faithfulness requirement.
